claim: In a CORS request to a bucket, the Origin header must match AllowedOrigins, the requested method must match AllowedMethods, and the headers of a preflight request must match AllowedHeaders.

evidence.quote: The `Origin` header in a CORS request to your bucket must match the origins in the `AllowedOrigins` element in your CORS configuration.
evidence.title: Using cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)

evidence.quote: The HTTP methods that are specified in the `Access-Control-Request-Method` in a CORS request to your bucket must match the method or methods listed in the `AllowedMethods` element in your CORS configuration.
evidence.title: Using cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)

evidence.quote: The headers listed in the `Access-Control-Request-Headers` header in a pre-flight request must match the headers in the `AllowedHeaders` element in your CORS configuration.
evidence.title: Using cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)
